title: SUPPORT MG KEEPS ACCELERATING
why: His words: the Support MG feels good but needs to increase its fire rate once fully spinning. The spin-up used to close the gap between rounds to the gun own 105 milliseconds and stop. Now it keeps closing as the barrels wind: the fire rate climbs through the whole spin-up and is about 1.3 times what it was once fully spinning (a gap of about 81 milliseconds), and it drops back down as the barrels wind down when you let go. You hear it and feel it: the report of every round rises in pitch with the rate, from a low note at the start of the spin to a bright one at full speed, and the controller rumble grows with it. This is a balance change, which his rule of 2 October allows: a full magazine of 60 is gone in about 4.9 seconds instead of 6.3, so the gun is worth more once it is spinning and costs more of your reserve. Only the Support MG, only in live play; the bot raids and the seeded stream are untouched.
now: The Support MG fires about 1.3 times faster once fully spinning, and its report rises in pitch with the rate.
